verdict.rationale: Whisper is offered as a hosted speech-to-text API as well as an open-source model, so asking whether it can issue scoped API credentials to an agent is fair. The evidence covers transcription, file formats, the CLI and the Python library, but nothing documents API key creation, permission scoping or least-privilege credentials. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
